context: M27 o1. (Delphine.) Rita's bar. Wurtz on a stool, mints, smiling. Brannock at the door.

lines.speaker: char.dennis_wurtz
lines.text: Delphine. Lovely evening. I hear the club moved its money. To Koreans. Clever.

lines.speaker: char.dennis_wurtz
lines.text: Fifty a week is a tax. All of it is a tax with a smile. Smile.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule fourteen, Lieutenant: never smile at a man who counts your teeth.

lines.speaker: char.dennis_wurtz
lines.text: Or give me a name. Somebody on this avenue talks downtown. Name, and I go away.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Ray Bauer. Since seventy-three. Now get out of Rita's bar.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Sugar… that man has three kids. You just sold him for a quiet month.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: I don't know any names, Lieutenant. I don't even own a radio.

lines.speaker: char.dennis_wurtz
lines.text: Then the club pays double till you remember. Good night.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: His photographs keep him safe. Then I need his photographs.
